C1684.title: Malicious PyPI Package 'perfviewer' Conducts Remote Windows Trojan Implantation
C1684.summary: On November 24, 2025, an attacker published five consecutive versions of a malicious PyPI package named 'perfviewer', leveraging dependency confusion techniques to trick developers into downloading it. Upon installation, the package executed a remote trojan implantation targeting Windows systems.

references.title: Supply Chain Poisoning Alert | Malicious Py Packages Deploy Windows Trojan via Remote Implantation - Zhihu
